rule: A green validator is evidence only for the obligations it explicitly checks. Do not infer coverage of unlisted semantics or runtime behavior.

checks: Generated README/START_HERE/Current-00/Current-01 are byte-identical to renderer output from Current/CURRENT_STATE.json.
Generated bootstrap/takeover files expose the current handover-preparation route stored in Current/CURRENT_STATE.json.
Generated latest-build status is state-driven so a preserved historical rejection can coexist with a later explicit lifecycle decision.
Generated runtime UX distinguishes a pending future test from upload of an already-completed run.
does_not_check: whether an arbitrary uncommitted handover response contains truthful current facts

RuntimeInbox/ACTIVE_BUILD.txt matches CURRENT_STATE.controllers.runtime_active_build and references a known build-lineage ID
BuildSpecs guarded base matches the currently accepted baseline
AUTO_BUILD_RESULT base SHA is validated against the latest artifact's lineage parent rather than the post-promotion controller base
canonical path existence
Knowledge topic routing/orphans
historical S1.42AC rejection SHA-provenance chain remains intact independently of the current artifact index
fresh S1.42AC corrected-acceptance runtime INDEX SHA agrees with Current/Projektstatus_S1.42AC_ACCEPTED.json and the current artifact evidence index
scan_scope: historical and fresh S1.42AC RuntimeEvidence indexes
does_not_check: Whether the user's local Gale installation actually contains the build named by ACTIVE_BUILD except insofar as the repository state was updated from user/runtime evidence
compilation or runtime correctness of arbitrary new source projects under Patches/ that have not entered the profile-build pipeline
whether the BCMER mathematical interpretation itself is correct independently of its decision evidence

CURRENT_STATE points to the canonical handover prompt

handover prompt retains required two-part output/runtime/fresh-state contract
handover prompt preserves completed-run log-upload handling and runtime-active/evidence-attribution semantics

GitHub Actions run status at the moment a future user triggers handover

actual SHA-256 and size of each current-critical linked raw LogOutput.log
agreement with runtime INDEX and embedded analysis source SHA

checks: Original S1.42AC rejection-era authoritative runtime-log SHA metadata chain
repository-wide qualification of the known superseded S1.42AC SHA
scan_scope: repository text files with supported suffixes

checks: Central known-bad-value registry across repository text
duplicate same-level current authority claims
orphan Knowledge topics
generated-file protection markers

predecessor PASS
checkpoint immutability
completion-commit existence
produced artifacts present in completion commit

backup-before-structural-migration provenance
historical/completion classifications required by the original overhaul contract

checks: Semantic routing for the maintained answerability case suite, including accepted build, BCMER, runtime uploader, roadmap and explicit new-chat handover queries
